title: unwrap_or fallback in finalize() masks state machine bugs
description: Line 969: `let rule_id = self.rule_id.unwrap_or(RULE_ID_A_TO_B)` - In finalize(), rule_id should always be set since it's assigned when receiving the first fragment. Using unwrap_or with a fallback could mask bugs where finalize is called in an invalid state. Should use `.expect("finalize called without rule_id")` or add explicit state validation before reaching this point.
